youtube_title: Cleaning Ears With Cotton Buds? You're Pushing It In | Body Fix #10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #10. Twisting a COTTON BUD in your ear after every bath?
B is right. Ears clean THEMSELVES. Wax moves out on its own.
Buds push wax DEEPER, can block the ear or hurt the eardrum.
Fix: Wipe the outer ear only. Nothing inside. NEVER hair pins or keys.
Red flags: Pain, discharge, hearing loss or dizziness? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Earwax build-up
